name: Guile of the Raptor

angles.text: As a warrior, you know Tor'gan hopes to rouse Gor'mul's dormant warrior spirit with raptors' cunning and ferocity.
As a member of the Horde, you see a tradition of drawing on primal beasts and natural spirits to restore purpose to a listless or troubled comrade.

faq.answer: Tor'gan is a spiritual figure who seeks to help Gor'mul. He believes Gor'mul has lost touch with his inner strength, so he gathers reagents for an item infused with beast magic to rouse him.
Gor'mul has lost his fighting spirit, and the warrior within him lies dormant. Tor'gan means to infuse him with primal predator essence, so Gor'mul can witness new power and rise to fight again.
Tor'gan needs twelve raptor hearts to make a physical talisman and weave the enchantment meant to infuse Gor'mul. Primal magic draws on predators' hearts to channel their instincts, guile, and power.
faq.q: Why does Tor'gan need raptor hearts?

faq.answer: The hearts come from Highland Fleshstalkers, predatory raptors known for relentless hunting and cunning. Tor'gan believes their hearts can fuel the spell that will awaken Gor'mul.
faq.q: Where do the raptor hearts come from?

aliases: what is guile of the raptor
faq.answer: The guile of the raptor means a predator's cunning, swift reflexes, and lethal instinct. Tor'gan believes this nature can break through Gor'mul's lethargy and revive his combat instincts.
faq.q: What does the guile of the raptor signify?

faq.answer: Tor'gan uses the gathered hearts to make an item and weave a spell. He hopes to show Gor'mul new power and awaken his dormant warrior identity, so Gor'mul can reclaim his path.
faq.q: What is the ultimate goal of the ritual?

sections.body: Tor'gan wants to draw Gor'mul out of his listlessness and restore the warrior spirit that lies dormant. He turns to primal magic instead of persuasion, hoping a charm filled with wild predators' essence will stir Gor'mul to action. Through the charm, he seeks to renew Gor'mul's martial resolve and show him the strength of this power.
sections.title: Awakening the Dormant Warrior

sections.body: Tor'gan needs Highland Fleshstalker hearts to call on the instincts of a cunning hunter. In shamanic and primal traditions, a predator's heart carries its ferocity and guile. Tor'gan uses these trophies to make a physical token and weave a spell. He hopes they will give Gor'mul a predator's cunning and help him rediscover his calling.
sections.title: The Heart of the Predator

summary: Tor'gan seeks to awaken Gor'mul's dormant warrior spirit through the guile of the raptor. He gathers Highland Fleshstalker hearts to make an enchanted charm and restore Gor'mul's fighting resolve.
attribution: In-game quest text: Guile of the Raptor
